name: theme-picker-previews
why: Bare `theme` searched YouTube for the word 'theme' and nothing listed the themes. `theme` opens a picker with every theme (13 presets in an empty library), each with a colour swatch and its motif; the highlighted one is previewed behind it (dream haze: its stars motif replaces neon rave's blocks). Descriptions that don't fit are cut at a word and end in … (they used to stop mid-word).

name: theme-picker-esc
why: Esc closes the picker and puts the theme you had back (neon rave's blocks motif).

name: theme-picker-enter-sticks
why: Enter keeps the highlighted theme like ◐ (a manual pick), so the next song's automatic restyle keeps its colours and motif.

name: theme-named
why: `theme <name>` picks a theme directly, ignoring case.

name: theme-named-typo
why: A near-miss name suggests the real one instead of searching.
expect: no theme velvt · did you mean velvet?

name: theme-named-song
why: `theme from shaft` is a song, not a theme: no theme is close, so it searches.
expect: no results for theme from shaft

name: theme-picker-brackets
why: An LLM-written theme name with [brackets] shows literally in the picker instead of being read as markup (or crashing). (Cut at a word with … at 74 wide.)

name: theme-picker-60
why: With 73 themes the list scrolls inside the popup (capped at 12 rows so the preview stays visible) and End reaches the last one.

name: theme-picker-song-change
why: A song change while the picker is open used to restyle under it: the automatic restyle (velvet → cinema) is held, so the previewed theme (retro tape, classic) stays on screen.

name: theme-picker-song-change-esc
why: …and Esc then goes to the new song's theme (cinema, hero layout), not the stale one from when the picker opened (velvet, focus).

name: theme-picker-tiny-window
why: In a 40x12 window the picker still opens, fits, and truncates rows instead of wrapping.

name: layout-picker-clip
why: In a small window the layout picker cuts descriptions at a word boundary with … instead of mid-word.
expect: needs a bigger window · four panels:…

name: theme-picker-keeps-picked-layout
why: Picking a theme by hand replaced a layout picked by hand (dashboard became the theme's stage). A theme pick changes colours and motif; a hand-picked layout stays.
